jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers. About the role The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄 Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most. Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities

jobs.description: You will be responsible for managing the Agile Robots Group’s patent, trademark and design portfolio. Based in Munich, you will work across a group with production sites in Europe, the Americas and Asia. The portfolio comprises more than 1,700 files. You will be supported by an IP Paralegal and a Chinese Patent Attorney based in China. External patent and trademark attorneys handle the drafting and filing of new applications. You will coordinate their work with inventors, business teams and other internal stakeholders, and report to the General Counsel of Agile Robots Group.   Your Responsibilities:  Manage the IP portfolio: Oversee pending applications and granted rights, regularly review their strategic value, and instruct external counsel on prosecution, maintenance and portfolio decisions. The portfolio covers Germany, European patents (including unitary patents and national validations), the US, China, Japan, Korea, India and other jurisdictions. Develop new IP: Serve as the main contact for inventors, product designers and marketing teams. Review invention disclosures, assess them against business priorities and applicable legal requirements, including the German Employee Inventions Act ( ArbnErfG ), and instruct external counsel on new applications. jobs.description: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About the Role:   The Space Operations team is crucial to Planet s success, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the health and productivity of the world s largest Earth Observation satellite constellation. Our team spans North America and Berlin. Given the scale of our fleet, automation is at the heart of our operations. You ll develop and maintain critical software, transforming large datasets into actionable metrics. As a Working Student, you ll support daily satellite operations, analyze data, triage and resolve anomalies, run on-orbit experiments, test and deploy software both on the ground and in orbit, and commission satellites. jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Life Sciences
jobs.description: This position is remote within the EMEA region, with the flexibility to work from our Munich or Budapest office. Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology. In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work." jobs.title: Online Marketing Multiplayer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Berlin · hybrid, in Ausnahmen remote · 20 Stunden pro Woche bis Vollzeit DigitalBegleiter ist eine Berliner Marketing- und Designagentur mit einem Fokus auf B2B-Marketing. Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische, oft inhaber- oder familiengeführte Unternehmen im DACH-Raum. Im B2C sind wir mit eigenen Beteiligungen und ausgewählten sehr bekannten Marken und people brands unterwegs. Wir arbeiten eng und direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammen, oft mit Inhabern und Geschäftsführung. Unsere Ad-Sprints messen wir an Demo-Anfragen, nicht an Klicks. Dafür suchen wir eine Allrounder-Persönlichkeit auf A-Player-Niveau. Eine, die sich schnell in neue Branchen und Themen einarbeitet und lieber Konzepte vorlegt, als auf Briefings zu warten. Was Du bewegst Du verantwortest Kampagnen von der Idee bis zur Anfrage. Du planst, baust und optimierst Google-Ads-Kampagnen – sauber strukturiert und auf Anfragen und Umsatz ausgerichtet. Wo es passt, bringst Du LinkedIn Ads und Meta Ads ins Spiel. Du entwickelst eigene Konzepte und Ideen und bringst sie ein, bevor jemand danach fragt. Du sorgst für sauberes Tracking und Reportings, die jeder Prüfung standhalten. Du nutzt KI im Alltag – für Analysen, Texte und Automatisierung – und machst unsere Prozesse damit schneller. Du bist nah am Kunden: in Calls, Workshops und Strategiegesprächen. Du gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten und hast großen Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit im Team. Was Du mitbringst Google Ads ist Pflicht: Du hast Konten eigenverantwortlich betreut und weißt, was ein sauberes Konto ausmacht – Struktur, Gebotsstrategien, Conversion-Tracking. B2B Fokus sehr erwünscht aber Ausnahmen sind auch willkommen. LinkedIn Ads sind ein Plus, Meta Ads sehr gern gesehen. Du arbeitest Dich eigenständig in neue Branchen, Themen und Kunden ein – auch in erklärungsbedürftige Tech-Produkte. Du denkst proaktiv und konzeptionell: Du siehst Potenziale und machst daraus konkrete Vorschläge. Du bist tech-affin: Tag Manager, Analytics, Consent-Tools, CMS und Shopsys

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel. By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost. Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control. Location While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain. This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms. About We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. We're hiring across multiple domains , so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand. We're building an AI-native engineering culture where engineers take ownership of problems

jobs.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About The Job Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on time series. jobs.description: Le Groupe Cybertek Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Employant 260 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plus de 100 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. Le Groupe Cybertek affirme son engagement en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle entre les femmes et les hommes et veille à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Au cœur de notre magasin, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour offrir à nos clients une expérience unique et de qualité. Vous serez chargé(e) de : •Accueillir, conseiller et accompagner nos clients, particuliers comme professionnels, dans leurs projets ; •Assembler des configurations PC (grand public, gaming et professionnel) sur mesure ; •Diagnostiquer et réparer les ordinateurs, en apportant des solutions adaptées ; •Prendre en charge le service après-vente (S.A.V.). Profil : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre écoute active, votre sens du service et votre envie de satisfaire les clients. Vous avez une solide connaissance des bases de l’informatique, couplée à une curiosité naturelle pour le hardware et le software. Vous êtes à l’aise pour conjuguer compétences humaines (accueil, communication) et savoir-faire technique (diagnostics, réparations). jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects. Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it

jobs.description: À propos de Dastra Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA . Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle , en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises. Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover , en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables . Le rôle En tant que Data Migration Project Manager , tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison. À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client , ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %) , tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données. Tes missions Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité. Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins. Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra Comprendre & structurer la data Analyser et structurer les données sources du client Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisée

jobs.title: Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Role overview Complex merchants can create complex financial crime risks. Their corporate structures, operating models and control environments may span entities, jurisdictions and teams. When concerns emerge, effective action depends on more than identifying the issue: someone must bring the right people together, agree a credible response, and keep remediation moving until it is complete. As Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager, you will provide that ownership. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects. Collaborating with cross-functional teams (designers, product managers, data analysts, backend engineers, adOps team) to build innovative monetization solutions that respect user experience. Building the bridge between advertisers/partners and our users, ensuring monetization feels native and non-intrusive. Optimizing performance and stability of monetization features to ensure seamless integration with the core BeReal experience. jobs.title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
jobs.description: À propos de Brixio Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. La mission L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans. Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe. Responsabilités Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration). Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security. Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs. Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client. OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et technique
